title: The Mysterious Great Attractor

scenes.text: Located near the Shapley Supercluster in the vicinity of the Centaurus constellation
The Great Attractor is pulling our galaxy, the Milky Way, and many others towards it at a rate of about 22 million kilometers per hour
The Great Attractor region as seen by the Hubble Space Telescope

scenes.label: Galactic Secret
scenes.text: What could be the cause of this phenomenon?
Follow if you can't stop asking why.

description: The Great Attractor is a region of space that is pulling our galaxy and many others towards it. What could be the cause of this phenomenon? Follow us for more space mysteries.
